title: How a Dehumidifier Works in 60 Seconds 💧🌬️ #shorts
description:
A dehumidifier makes rain indoors. A fan pulls damp air over a coil chilled by refrigerant, water vapour condenses into drops that fall into a tank, and a warm coil reheats the now-dry air before it goes back into the room. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#dehumidifier #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A dehumidifier makes *rain indoors*. A big one can pull about 50 litres of water out of the air in a day.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: A *fan* pulls damp room air into the machine, full of invisible water vapour.

steps.label: Cold coil
steps.text: The air crosses a *cold coil*, chilled by refrigerant that a compressor keeps pumping around.

steps.label: Condense
steps.text: The air cools below its dew point, so the vapour *condenses* into droplets, just like on a cold glass.

steps.label: Tank
steps.text: The drops run off the coil and drip down into a *collection tank* you empty later.

steps.label: Reheat
steps.text: The dry air then passes a *warm coil*, heats back up, and flows out into the room.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Chill, *drip*, dry. Follow Inside 60 for more.
